$description: D6 — the exclusion register and the watchlist, as the records Phase 2 item 2.1 would add to data/. PROPOSED in v2 Session 2; nothing here is in data/. instrument_updates.why: Coherence with the edges above (rule M-15). The record's proposes_to_amend lists dga, but COM(2025) 837 proposes to REPEAL the DGA (Art. 10(3)(a); title: 'repealing … (EU) 2022/868'), and it omits the CER Directive, which Art. 9 amends ('Amendments to Directive (EU) 2022/2557'; title: 'amending … Directives … (EU) 2022/2557'). A factual correction to an existing record: amber, for the author (docs/V2-DATA-DESIGN.md §7, F-2 and F-3). No field records a repeal proposed by a proposal; the repeals are carried by the two relationships rel-data-omnibus-*-repeals, and §1.4 recommends deriving these arrays from the relationships altogether.
